fields.description: Off until you switch it on. Review the thresholds below first: once it is on, requests for purchases start to appear for your real stock. Switching it off again stops that; requests that are already waiting stay as they are.
fields.label: Watch stock

fields.description: Munimji asks for a purchase when either rule below says stock is running low.
fields.label: When to ask for a purchase

fields.description: A quantity, counted warehouse by warehouse. Leave 0 to not use this rule.
fields.label: Ask when stock is at or below this quantity (0 = not used)

fields.description: Worked out from how much of the item you have been using. Leave 0 to not use this rule.
fields.label: Ask when stock will last this many days or fewer (0 = not used)

fields.description: Ask early enough for the supplier to deliver: when the days of stock left are no more than the delivery time plus the safety days.
fields.label: Also ask in time for the delivery

fields.description: Extra days of stock to keep on top of the delivery time.
fields.label: Safety days

fields.description: Used for an item when ERPNext has no delivery time for it.
fields.label: Delivery time to assume (days)

fields.description: How often stock is checked, and how much of your past use is looked at.
fields.label: When to check, and what history to look at

fields.description: A schedule in cron form: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. 0 6 * * * is every day at 6 in the morning, in this site's time zone. ERPNext's scheduler runs a job every 4 minutes at the soonest.
fields.label: Check stock at

fields.description: The latest days, to notice that use is speeding up or slowing down.
fields.label: Recent use: look back this many days

fields.description: The longer stretch that tells what normal use is. It must be more than the recent days.
fields.label: Normal use: look back this many days

fields.description: How much past use is read from ERPNext. About 15 months or more lets last year's season count.
fields.label: Read this many days of history

fields.description: Festivals and promotions, when you use more or less than usual.
fields.label: Demand calendar

fields.description: Each event applies to every item. Choosing items or item groups for an event comes later.
fields.label: Events

fields.description: A request nobody answers is closed after this long. It is never approved on its own.
fields.label: A request expires after (hours)

fields.description: One reminder goes to the approvers if there is still no answer after this long.
fields.label: Remind after (hours)

fields.description: A short note inside this site when stock is low, before any purchase is asked for. Nothing is sent out of the site.
fields.label: Send stock alerts

fields.description: An item that is still low gets the same alert again after this many days. A worse level is always sent at once.
fields.label: Repeat an alert after (days)

fields.description: A request for an item that has no supplier of its own goes to this one.
fields.label: Supplier to use when an item has none
